about_the_game:
Welcome to Candyworld!
Amazing adventures, games, fun and imminent death await you here.
How fortunate that you've woken up right now - very soon, a magical tea party will take place in the Cloudhouse, which all residents of Candyworld dream of attending. You should definitely get to know them - we all love guests very much!
At the tea party, you will meet our incomparable Redheart Queen - there is no other person more beautiful and kind in the world! The queen will fulfill any wish that her loyal subjects make at a tea party. I hope you know what you're going to wish for.
The road to the palace may seem difficult to you - on your way you will encounter many dangers and mysteries. But believe me, your suffering is nothing compared to the greatness of our queen!
I've heard that since your arrival in Candyworld, the memory of the past has left you. Perhaps you would like to restore it? The queen will help you with this matter, but remember: the less you know, the more blissfully you sleep.
Accept this invitation - I will be waiting for you in the Cloudhouse. And don't forget to smile, because life in Candyworld is a miracle!
Yours truly, Porcelainy - the royal messenger.

Gameplay

"Teaparty in Candyworld" is a classic horror novel with choices and advanced functionality: riddles, puzzles, quest elements and research. Immerse in a magical world full of secrets and illusions. Be careful and do not lose your vigilance - every step you take may be your last.

Gameplay Features:
• Logic puzzles
• Interaction with the pseudo open world, exploration of some locations
• The function of skipping puzzles, which opens after the first complete passage
• Chapter selection before starting the game

In the early access of the game, the choices do not have a significant impact on the ending.
The game includes the first episode, early game materials, a chance to earn a unique achievement and access to all subsequent updates.

Graphics

The game has the author's 2D graphics - it combines fabulous paintings, fear and a tense atmosphere to create a unique, fascinating and terrifying world from children's dreams. Or from nightmares?

Communication with the developer

The game is fully developed by one person. If you encounter difficulties or technical problems during the game, please contact me.

Wake up from your dream to enter this world and recall everything - Candyworld is waiting for you.

short_description: Read the story from beginning to end, solve all the puzzles and unravel the creepy history of Candyworld. Accept the invitation to the tea party and make a choice - escape forever or stop the destruction of the magical world.
